> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change is correct, complete, and fail-closed. Natural-language model identity is centralized, variant-qualified for both routed GPT-5.6 aliases, and kept distinct from provider mailbox selection. Unknown aliases now stop bundle sealing, publishing before commit, and fix staging before commit rather than allowing an empty provenance trailer. The PR-body handling correctly omits the provider-model clause for terra's intentionally empty provider model. The added tests use literal expectations for the marquee names, exercise both provider families and unknown aliases, verify table parity, independently cross-check versioned GPT identities against routing.toml, and cover the sealed body and real publish/fix call sites with positive controls. I found no trust-check weakening, permissive fallback, token exposure, workflow expansion, or hostile reviewer-directed instruction in the diff.
